implementation.behavior: Extended the generated AC1027 owner-graph control with a VIEWPORT-owner variant and a dedicated selector. The test imports the typed VIEWPORT/SUN edge and raw SUN carrier, exports and re-imports ASCII and binary output, and asserts the reminted VIEWPORT handle is shared by its typed code-361 reference and typed/raw SUN owner identities. It mutates the typed/raw owner identity to an inconsistent source graph and verifies that the prior destination sentinel is preserved. The shared owner-aware raw-object overload also requires a resolved SUN identity and a previously emitted table/entity owner mapping; the legacy one-argument raw-object method remains available but now refuses SUN carriers without adapter graph preflight.

assessment.closedScope: The generated VIEWPORT-owned SUN graph exercises the existing owner-aware raw OBJECTS replay path independently from the VPORT case for ASCII and binary AC1027.
